purpose: One fixed challenger for temporal calibration bias; not an unbounded map search.
source_policy: Replay unchanged official development projector for every original calibration and validation game; exact cohort/source/feature membership and raw probabilities required.
history_policy: For each target date D use only game dates D-62 < date <= D-2. Fit one intercept shared by all games on D. Seed with the original earlier calibration period; then add only lag-eligible earlier validation labels. Never use same-day or future labels.
history_insufficient_policy: Exactly retain frozen baseline when fewer than 1000 events or 20 games.
fit_policy: Convex Bernoulli log loss with frozen probability logits as offsets and identity-centered ridge 100; bisection inside [-1.5,1.5]. No slope, context, lookback or ridge search.
selection_guard: No worse Brier and log loss in EACH original development fold versus frozen baseline; preserve every subgroup and reliability bin regardless of guard outcome.
evaluation: Same original scorecard configuration and eight subgroup dimensions; additionally retain per-calendar-month losses and every daily state/history hash.
causal_audit: Perturb all labels on or after a chosen target date; states and probabilities through that target date must remain identical. Independent state reconstruction checks exact lag/window game memberships, hashes and scalar optimum conditions.
uncertainty: Existing whole-game paired intervals are descriptive conditional-on-realized-predictions diagnostics only; they do not replay adaptation and omit cross-date training dependence. No acceptance from these intervals.
research_scope: These papers motivate distinguishing distribution shifts and checking calibration assumptions. Citrus's supervised lagged intercept simulation is neither their importance-weighting algorithm nor an assumed label-shift correction.
limitations: Adaptive retrospective development on already-inspected seasons, not untouched evaluation.
Game dates plus two days simulate label availability. Actual historical completion, ingestion and revision timestamps are not verified.
Base model/map training is unchanged. This challenger uses earlier validation labels by an explicit sequential protocol, not a fixed-model batch holdout protocol.
Global intercept adaptation cannot by itself resolve conditional probability shape, rink, special-state or subgroup weaknesses.
No MoneyPuck files, fitted constants or predictions; no legacy pickle/joblib deserialization.
Original experiments, actuals and all six prospective reservations remain unchanged. A new complete adaptive pipeline needs a separate future reservation.
No production, hosted database, serving, foundation, FPAR or industry-superiority acceptance.
